description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) API in PyTorch, including configuration policies for mixed precision, communication primitives, and offload policies. It appears to be part of the internal implementation of the distributed FSDP feature.

classes.name: MixedPrecisionPolicy
classes.description: Configures FSDP's mixed precision settings at the module level, including data types for parameters, gradients, and outputs, as well as whether to cast inputs.

classes.name: Comm
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface for communication primitives used in distributed training.

classes.name: AllGather
classes.description: Interface for the all_gather collective communication primitive.

classes.name: ReduceScatter
classes.description: Interface for the reduce_scatter collective communication primitive.

classes.name: OffloadPolicy
classes.description: Base class representing the default (no offloading) policy.

classes.name: CPUOffloadPolicy
classes.description: Offload policy implementing CPU offloading of parameters, gradients, and optimizer states, with optional pinned memory for efficiency.

methods.description: Abstract method for memory allocation in communication primitives.

methods.description: Abstract method for performing the communication operation, such as all_gather or reduce_scatter.
